messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT - private-cluster-42: GPU pending queue rising above threshold (5m avg). Auto-scale attempted and failed. Paging oncall.

maria: paging @samir (oncall) -- seeing huge pending pods for customer-x. TL;DR: ~3.8k pods pending, scheduler backpressure.

samir: on it. looking at autoscaler logs now. Can you drop kubectl get pods -n customer-x --field-selector=status.phase==Pending | wc -l?

maria: ran it: 3842

ops-bot: autoscaler-error: scaleUp: failed to create instance - Error: "QuotaExceeded: Could not create instances (region-us-west-2)". recent events: [ProvisioningFailed, AttachENINetworkError].

samir: that matches what i'm seeing. autoscaler tried to launch g5 instances but cloud API returned 403 quota. Also several nodes stuck in 'Provisioning' for >15m due to ENI allocation failures.

jon: customer-x support pinged: they report inference 95p latency spiking and 503s for sessions created via private endpoint. They've opened an internal support thread.

customer-x-support: Confirming. Impact: degraded realtime inference for two services, ~30% request errors, backfilled batch jobs also delayed. Customer is seeing queue timeouts at 45s. They asked if we can failover to hosted fallback.

samir: mitigation plan: 1) evict low-priority batch pods in customer-x NS (we have preemptable label) 2) try to increase nodeGroup max size + request quota bump from cloud team 3) if still blocked, enable routing -> hosted cluster for critical routes via smart-routing rules. Starting step 1 now.

maria: step 1 in progress: running kubectl -n customer-x delete pod -l workload=batch,priority=low --grace-period=0 --force

samir: step 1 completed. freed ~900 pending slots. pending count now: 2950. Still high.

ops-bot: cluster-events: CNIAllocationFailure observed on nodes a-c. Kernel logs show "ipam: no available addresses" and "attach failed: network resource quota exceeded".

samir: so two issues: cloud instance quota + VPC IP exhaustion for customer's private subnet. Need cloud provider ticket for ENI/IP limit and ask customer to increase / free subnet IPs OR we fallback to hosted.

elaine: i'm taking 2nd shift in 30m. quick question: do we already have a hosted fallback runbook for customer-x routes?

maria: yes. runbook at /runbooks/private-fallback.md. We can enable per-route failover for model endpoints; it's a config flip in the control plane and requires toggling 'allow-hosted-fallback' for that tenant. Also need to notify infra to open a temporary quota increase on cloud account.

infra-oncall: opened provider ticket #PROV-4382 requesting ENI/ip quota increase and expedited g5 quota. ETA from provider: initial response 2h, resolution TBD. Requested temporary spot-burst permission.

samir: while we wait, i'm going to mark critical routes for model: "vision-large" and "chat-prod" to allow hosted routing. Steps: update routing policy -> scale hosted replica count to absorb ~200 RPS -> monitor error rate. Doing it now.

maria: toggled allow-hosted-fallback for those routes. Hosted side autoscaling triggered and added 12 replicas. We'll route ~45% of traffic by weight to hosted.

customer-x-support: Confirm: error rate dropped from 30% to ~6% for critical endpoint. Non-critical batch still delayed but customers accept this for now. Thanks.

samir: good. mitigation successful for critical user paths. still open: reduce pending queue, get provider quota fixed, and postmortem.

ops-bot: incident-status: mitigation=partial, severity=sev2, started=1823456789, current_pending=2124, error_rate_critical=6%.

samir: handing off to @elaine for overnight. Handoff notes:
- root cause: combined cloud quota(ENI/instance) + customer VPC IP exhaustion blocked node provisioning.
- actions taken: evicted ~900 low-priority pods, toggled hosted fallback for critical routes, opened provider ticket PROV-4382, notified customer and support.
- followups: schedule deep-dive with networking + infra, consider pre-provision and IP management checks for private clusters, add alert for ENIAllocFailures.

elaine: ack. i'll monitor provider ticket and keep hosted-fallback enabled until we confirm capacity backfills or customer network changes. i'll also post an incident summary to #postmortems tomorrow.

samir: leaving channel. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE - private-cluster-42: mitigation partial. Handoff to elaine (oncall). New ticket created: INC-2026.

elaine: adding to calendar: follow-up call with customer-x at 10:00 PT tomorrow. I'll draft initial postmortem and tag eng-networking + infra.

jon: small note for postmortem: include the autoscaler logs and the exact timestamps of failed API calls. we should also add a test for Route failover automation so we can flip earlier next time.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT STATUS CHANGE - private-cluster-42: monitored -> partial-mitigated at 1823457800.
